verses.text: Jesus left the temple and was walking away. His disciples came over to point out the temple buildings.
He answered, “You see all these buildings? I’m telling you the truth: not one stone will stay on top of another. Everything will be torn down.”
As Jesus sat on the Mount of Olives, his disciples came privately and asked, “Tell us, when will this happen? What sign will show you’re coming and this age is ending?”
Jesus answered, “Watch out so nobody misleads you.”
“Many will come using my name, saying, ‘I am the Christ,’ and they’ll mislead many.”
“You’ll hear about wars and rumors of wars. Don’t panic; these things have to happen, but the end isn’t here yet.”
“Nation will rise against nation, kingdom against kingdom. There’ll be famines, plagues, and earthquakes in different places.”
“All this is just the beginning of birth pains.”
“Then they’ll hand you over to be oppressed and killed. All nations will hate you because of my name.”
“Many will turn away, betray one another, and hate one another.”
“Many false prophets will show up and mislead lots of people.”
“As lawlessness spreads, many people’s love will grow cold.”
“But the one who stands firm to the end will be saved.”
“This Good News of the Kingdom will be announced throughout the whole world as a witness to all nations. Then the end will come.”
“So when you see the ‘abomination of desolation’ Daniel the prophet spoke about standing in the holy place—reader, understand this—”
“then those in Judea must run for the mountains.”
“If you’re on the rooftop, don’t go back inside to grab your things.”
“If you’re out in the field, don’t turn back to get your coat.”
“How hard it’ll be for pregnant women and nursing mothers in those days!”
“Pray you won’t have to flee in winter or on the Sabbath.”
“There’ll be suffering unlike anything from the beginning of the world until now—and nothing like it will happen again.”
“If those days weren’t cut short, no one would survive. But for the sake of the chosen ones, those days will be cut short.”
“If anyone tells you, ‘Look, the Christ is here!’ or ‘There he is!’ don’t believe it.”
“False Christs and false prophets will appear and show great signs and wonders, trying to mislead even the chosen ones, if they can.”
“Look, I’ve told you ahead of time.”
“So if people say, ‘He’s out in the wilderness,’ don’t go out. If they say, ‘He’s in the inner rooms,’ don’t believe them.”
“Just as lightning flashes from east to west, that’s how the coming of the Son of Man will be.”
“Wherever there’s a dead body, that’s where the vultures gather.”
“Right after the suffering of those days, the sun will go dark, the moon won’t shine, stars will fall from the sky, and the powers of the heavens will be shaken.”
“Then the sign of the Son of Man will appear in the sky. All the tribes of the earth will mourn, and they’ll see the Son of Man coming on the clouds with power and great glory.”
“He’ll send his angels with a loud trumpet call, and they’ll gather his chosen ones from the four winds—from one end of heaven to the other.”
“Learn this from the fig tree: when its branch gets tender and leaves come out, you know summer is close.”
“In the same way, when you see all these things, know that he’s near—right at the door.”
“I’m telling you the truth: this generation won’t pass away until all these things happen.”
“Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words won’t pass away.”
“Nobody knows the day or hour—not even heaven’s angels. Only my Father knows.”
“The coming of the Son of Man will be like it was in Noah’s days.”
“Before the flood, people were eating, drinking, getting married, and arranging marriages, right up until the day Noah entered the ark.”
“They didn’t realize what was happening until the flood came and swept them all away. That’s how the Son of Man’s coming will be.”
“Two men will be in a field: one will be taken, and one left.”
“Two women will be grinding grain: one will be taken, and one left.”
“So stay alert—you don’t know what hour your Lord is coming.”
“Know this: if the homeowner knew what part of the night a thief was coming, he’d stay awake and wouldn’t let the thief break in.”
“So stay ready too. The Son of Man will come at an hour you don’t expect.”
“Who’s the faithful, wise servant the master put in charge of the household, to give everyone food at the right time?”
“Blessed is that servant if the master comes back and finds him doing his job.”
“I’m telling you the truth: the master will put him in charge of everything he owns.”
“But if that bad servant thinks, ‘My master is taking forever to come back,’”
“and starts beating the other servants, eating and drinking with drunk people,”
“his master will come on a day he doesn’t expect, at an hour he doesn’t know,”
“cut him to pieces, and give him the same fate as the hypocrites. That’s where there’ll be weeping and grinding of teeth.”
